ValidationRule.description: #29675-Opportunity: New Lost Reason - "Sales Ops Hygiene" & "Booking Policy Violation" only SOps can select
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Lost"), OR( ISPICKVAL(IM_Reason_Lost__c , "Booking Policy Violation"), ISPICKVAL(IM_Reason_Lost__c , "Sales Ops Hygiene"), ISPICKVAL(IM_Reason_Lost__c , "Cancelled after Signing")), $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Sales Ops Super User', $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin', $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The "Lost Reason" you have selected is only available to certain users. Please select another reason from the drop down list. Need Help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
